decisions.reason: Eliminating Big Blocks does not change the approved badges, referral milestones, badge storage, or cosmetic badge behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block descriptions and updates the primary-mint allocation and Small Block FAQ copy.
The existing event correctly removes Big Block references but also changes prize collection from one-click claiming to automatic payment, which the source does not establish.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and Small Block ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket for the current block, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards continuing $500 prizes, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF; do not describe a Big Block prize.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the Small-and-Big prize copy with Small Block-only prize copy.
Fiat wallet provisioning and access to NFTs, commissions, and remaining Small Block prizes remain valid without modification.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket from the no-referral reward components while retaining the commission and Small Block ticket.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block eligibility and scope while preserving Small Block Chainlink VRF selection.
The existing same-message MODIFY already reduces ticket awards and counters to Small Block and removes both obsolete Big Block lifecycle keys.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block from the secondary-royalty prize-pool destinations while leaving royalty enforcement unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the new $5 primary-mint contribution to the continuing Small Block prize pool.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records the $5 founder share, $5 affiliate commission, $5 Small Block pool allocation, and removal of Big Block as a destination.
Prize-winner email notifications remain applicable to the continuing Small Block prizes, and the source does not change email delivery behavior.
